name: Leban Street
title: Leban Street - Restaurant Ordering & Operations
description: An active restaurant platform I built that the business continues to use. It connects customer ordering and checkout with kitchen, sales, inventory, and super admin dashboards for managing orders, stock, and revenue.
notes: Built the customer ordering frontend and operational dashboards for kitchen preparation, sales order handling, inventory and raw materials, and super admin revenue and cost reporting. Connected these API-backed interfaces with role-specific navigation and state management.

name: PAWEN
title: PAWEN - Event Website & Participation Flows
description: A connected frontend for the PAWEN Summit, Exhibition, and Awards Gala. It combines Contentful-backed speakers and awards content with nominations, registration and exhibitor forms, travel guidance, and a digital helpdesk integration.
notes: Implemented the full public-facing frontend, including responsive event pages, Contentful content presentation, multi-step participation forms connected to Jotform, travel information, Nviti helpdesk integration, and consent-aware analytics.

name: SwiftLink
title: SwiftLink - Self-Initiated Fintech Product
description: A self-initiated fintech product I built across the frontend and backend. SwiftLink connects bill purchases and bank-transfer wallet funding with provider reconciliation, customer support, and operational dashboards for administrators.
notes: Built the Next.js frontend and Express backend for OTP onboarding, transaction PIN flows, service purchases, wallet funding, callbacks, and reconciliation. Added customer history, receipts, beneficiaries, support, and admin reporting with user, wallet, and administrator-management workflows.

name: OpenRoleHQ
title: OpenRoleHQ - AI Job Search Workspace
description: A candidate-facing job-search workspace. I built frontend flows for authentication, guided onboarding, profile and résumé management, AI-assisted writing, application tracking, subscriptions, and browser-extension connection.
notes: Built API-backed candidate interfaces with Next.js, SWR, and Zustand, covering account state, onboarding, profile editing, application search and filtering, AI writing tools, billing, and extension setup. Also worked on public collection submissions and Contentful-backed product content.

name: HRIS
title: HRIS - Employee & HR Operations
description: An HR platform frontend connecting employee self-service with administrator workflows for onboarding, staff records, document review, leave approvals, offboarding, and workforce analytics.
notes: Built API-connected employee and administrator interfaces for account access, multi-step onboarding, staff records, document handling, leave review, and offboarding. Shared form validation, SWR data hooks, workforce tables, and reporting charts support these operational workflows.
